paragraphs: I confirm that I am at least 19 years old and that HanBuddy is available for registration and use by adults only.
I have read the full HanBuddy Terms of Service and agree to them.
I have read the following information about the collection and use of personal information and agree to it.

details.label: Data collected
details.value: Google account identifier, email, name, profile image, nickname, nationality, date of birth, preferred contact method, contact identifier or phone number

details.label: Purpose
details.value: Registration and login, identity and age verification, profiles, communication between booking parties, account security and customer support

details.label: Retention period
details.value: Until account closure. Contract, payment, dispute and consent records are retained separately for the periods required by law.

details.label: Right to refuse and consequences
details.value: You may refuse consent, but registration and Service use will be difficult because this information is required.

paragraphs: I have read the Buddy Operating Terms and agree to accurate activity information, booking fulfillment, safety measures, protection of users’ personal information and community standards.

I have read the Buddy Commission and Settlement Policy. I acknowledge total deductions from actual sales of 22% for standard Buddies (20% platform fee plus 2% VAT on the fee) and 11% for Early Buddies (10% fee plus 1% VAT).
I also agree to the displayed settlement schedule and treatment of cancellations, refunds and chargebacks.
I agree to receive marketing emails. I may withdraw consent at any time through account settings or the unsubscribe function in emails.
